title: Modularize ChatToolCatalog into domain registries and shared schema helpers
description:
Problem: `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` is now 1,161 lines and mixes tool registration, executable handlers, JSON schema builders, formatting helpers, and context-item conversion for a rapidly growing MCP/chat tool surface. The next active MCP backlog items (`TSK-0183`, `TSK-0185`, `TSK-0186`) all touch this file, and there is no architecture task that owns the registry structure itself.

Evidence from 2026-05-26 audit:
- Largest-file scan listed `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` at 1,161 lines.
- The file currently yields 19 `ChatToolDescriptor` registrations and also owns schema builders such as `BuildSearchSchema`, `BuildContextPackSchema`, `BuildSourceBundleSchema`, and multiple task-tool schemas.
- Search of `Data/Tasks` found task coverage for MCP features and docs, but no first-class modularization task for `ChatToolCatalog` itself.
- Upcoming tasks `TSK-0185` and `TSK-0186` would otherwise add more behavior to the same hotspot.

Desired outcome: keep the current tool contracts stable while moving registrations and schema helpers into domain-owned modules so new MCP/chat tool work no longer expands one monolithic registry file.

Scope:
- In scope: grouping tool descriptors by domain (for example memory/search, pages, tasks, source, diagnostics) and extracting shared schema/format helpers where appropriate.
- In scope: preserving tool names, availability flags, risk tiers, auth semantics, and output formats.
- Out of scope: changing public tool names or redesigning existing tool behavior beyond the structural extraction.

Dependencies:
- Coordinate with `TSK-0183`, `TSK-0185`, `TSK-0186`, `TSK-0177`, `TSK-0151`, and `TSK-0159` so structural work does not fork policy decisions.

Acceptance criteria:
- `ChatToolCatalog.cs` no longer contains all tool registrations and schema builders in one file.
- Domain-specific tool additions can land in bounded registry files or helpers without changing the central contract surface broadly.
- Existing MCP/chat tool behavior remains unchanged under focused tests.

Validation:
- Run focused `McpAndSemanticSearchTests`, `ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests`, and any diagnostics/security slices affected by the extraction.
- Run `dotnet build MemorySmith.slnx -v minimal`.
- Run `./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1` after task creation/update.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created during the 2026-05-26 untracked-gap audit after verifying that multiple active MCP/tool tasks keep converging on `ChatToolCatalog.cs` with no owning modularization task.
